description: BPSC TRE Computer Science Model Test Paper containing 150 questions across Language, General Studies, and Computer Science.

questions.questionText: I have a friend in Mumbai who is _______ actress.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The word 'actress' begins with a vowel sound, so the indefinite article 'an' is appropriate.

questions.questionText: In this school, all _______ students are given free education.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: When referring to a specific group of students within a particular institution, the definite article 'the' is used after 'all'.

questions.questionText: If you reach _______ airport on time, you will catch the flight.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The context implies the specific airport from which the designated flight departs, requiring 'the'.

questions.questionText: You should go for _______ early morning walk.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The phrase 'early morning walk' starts with a vowel sound in 'early', taking the indefinite article 'an'.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a river?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bay of Bengal is a bay/sea, whereas Godavari and Ganga are rivers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a part of drawing room?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Neither a washing machine nor a chimney is a standard fixture of a drawing room, making 'More than one of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: Today is Sunday. The day before yesterday was:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: If today is Sunday, yesterday was Saturday and the day before yesterday was Friday.

questions.questionText: Husband's brother is called:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A spouse's brother is referred to as brother-in-law.

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 'प्रत्यय-रहित' शब्द है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'भावविह्वल' दो स्वतंत्र शब्दों (भाव + विह्वल) के योग से बना सामासिक पद है, इसमें कोई प्रत्यय नहीं जुड़ा है।

questions.questionText: भाषा की सबसे उपयुक्त परिभाषा क्या है?
questions.optionA: विचार या भाव प्रकट करने वाला सार्थक ध्वनिसमूह भाषा कहलाता है
questions.optionB: विचार या भाव को लिपि-चिह्नों में प्रकट करने को भाषा कहते हैं
questions.optionC: विचार या भाव प्रकट करने का साधन भाषा है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: आधिकारिक परीक्षा उत्तर के अनुसार भाषा विचार या भाव प्रकट करने का साधन है।

questions.questionText: स्वर के कितने मुख्य भेद/प्रकार हैं?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: मात्रा या उच्चारण काल के आधार पर स्वर के मुख्य रूप से दो भेद (ह्रस्व और दीर्घ) माने जाते हैं।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से ह्रस्व स्वर कौन-सा है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: हिंदी वर्णमाला में 'अ' एक मूल ह्रस्व स्वर है।

questions.questionText: उच्चारण के आधार पर व्यंजनों का वर्गीकरण कितने भागों में किया जा सकता है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रयत्न और उच्चारण स्थान के आधार पर व्यंजनों का वर्गीकरण आठ वर्गों में किया जाता है।

questions.questionText: इनमें से 'अल्पप्राण' ध्वनि कौन-सी है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: प्रत्येक स्पर्श वर्ग का पहला, तीसरा और पाँचवाँ वर्ण अल्पप्राण होता है। अतः 'च' अल्पप्राण है।

questions.questionText: इनमें से 'घोष' ध्वनि कौन-सी है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: वर्गों के तृतीय, चतुर्थ और पंचम वर्ण घोष होते हैं; ग, ज और ध तीनों ही घोष ध्वनियाँ हैं।

questions.questionText: 'अग्नि' शब्द का विशेषण रूप क्या होगा?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'अग्नि' का व्याकरणिक विशेषण रूप 'आग्नेय' होता है।

questions.questionText: हिंदी वर्णमाला में प्रकंपी (लुंठित) व्यंजन कौन-सा है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'र' के उच्चारण में जिह्वाग्र कंपित होता है, इसलिए इसे प्रकंपी अथवा लुंठित व्यंजन कहते हैं।

questions.questionText: अर्ध-स्वर किन्हें माना जाता है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: हिंदी ध्वनिविज्ञान में 'य' और 'व' दोनों को अर्ध-स्वर माना जाता है।

questions.questionText: (क) केकी, (ख) विहंग, (ग) खग, (घ) पिक — विकल्पों में से कौन-सा युग्म 'पक्षी' का पर्यायवाची है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'विहंग' और 'खग' दोनों पक्षी के पर्यायवाची शब्द हैं।

questions.questionText: 'जिसे बुलाया न गया हो' वाक्यांश के लिए एक उपयुक्त शब्द क्या होगा?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: बिना बुलाए आने वाले अथवा जिसे आमंत्रित न किया गया हो, उसे 'अनाहूत' कहा जाता है।

questions.questionText: रचना के आधार पर कौन-सा विकल्प वाक्य का भेद नहीं है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: रचना के आधार पर वाक्य के तीन भेद होते हैं: सरल, संयुक्त और मिश्र। 'उपवाक्य' वाक्य का अंग है, भेद नहीं।

questions.questionText: जिन शब्दों से न्यूनता, लघुता, हीनता या तुच्छता का बोध हो, उन्हें क्या कहते हैं?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: लघुता, हीनता अथवा तुच्छता का भाव प्रकट करने वाले शब्दों को ऊनार्थक शब्द कहा जाता है।

questions.questionText: रचना के आधार पर 'जल' शब्द किस कोटि का है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: जिन शब्दों के सार्थक खंड न किए जा सकें, वे रूढ़ शब्द कहलाते हैं। 'जल' एक रूढ़ शब्द है।

questions.questionText: "उदित उदयगिरि मंच पर रघुवर बाल पतंग। बिकसे संत सरोज सब हरषे लोचन भृंग।।" इस दोहे में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: यहाँ उपमेय और उपमान में अभेद स्थापित किया गया है, अतः सांग रूपक अलंकार है।

questions.questionText: 'दुकान पर कोई नहीं था।' वाक्य में किस कारक का चिह्न प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: आधार या स्थान को व्यक्त करने के लिए अधिकरण कारक ('पर') का प्रयोग हुआ है।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से तत्सम शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'पुष्प' संस्कृत का मूल तत्सम शब्द है, जिसका तद्भव रूप फूल होता है।

questions.questionText: 'उत्कृष्ट' शब्द का सही विलोम शब्द है:
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'उत्कृष्ट' का विलोम शब्द 'निकृष्ट' होता है।

questions.questionText: 'खटाई में पड़ना' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'खटाई में पड़ना' का अर्थ होता है किसी काम का रुक जाना, टल जाना या झमेले में पड़ जाना।

questions.questionText: 'जहाँ लोगों का मिलन हो' वाक्यखंड के लिए एक शब्द है:
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: जहाँ अनेक लोगों का औपचारिक मिलन या सभा हो, उसे 'सम्मेलन' कहते हैं।

questions.questionText: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'कवयित्री' और 'उज्ज्वल' दोनों ही मानक शुद्ध वर्तनी हैं, अतः 'उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक' सही है।

questions.questionText: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 5?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Three-digit numbers range from 100 to 999. The sequence is 100, 105, ..., 995. Total count = ((995 - 100) / 5) + 1 = 180.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The product simplifies telescopically: (3/2) * (4/3) * (5/4) * ... * (121/120) = 121 / 2 = 60.5.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: (1/2) * (2/3) * (3/4) * ... * ((n-1)/n) cancels intermediate terms, yielding 1/n.

questions.questionText: Two persons A and B complete a task in 15 days when working together. Person A completes the task in 20 days working alone. How many days will B take alone?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rate of B = 1/15 - 1/20 = (4 - 3)/60 = 1/60, so B alone takes 60 days.

questions.questionText: The cost of carpeting a room 18 m long with a carpet 75 cm wide at Rs. 4.50 per metre is Rs. 810. The breadth of the room is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Carpet length = 810 / 4.5 = 180 m. Area = 180 * 0.75 = 135 sq m. Breadth = 135 / 18 = 7.5 m.

questions.questionText: 10% loss on selling price is what percent loss on cost price?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: A shopkeeper purchases an item at Rs. 615 and sells it at Rs. 820. What is his percentage profit?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The ratio of the ages of two brothers is 4:3. If the elder brother is 6 years older than the younger one, then their ages (in years) are:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let ages be 4x and 3x. 4x - 3x = x = 6. The ages are 24 and 18 years.

questions.questionText: By what least number should 81 be divided to get a perfect cube?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 81 = 3 * 3 * 3 * 3. Dividing by 3 leaves 27 = 3^3, which is a perfect cube.

questions.questionText: If $(-3)^{m+1} \times (-3)^5 = (-3)^7$, then the value of $m$ is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Equating exponents: (m + 1) + 5 = 7 => m + 6 = 7 => m = 1.

questions.questionText: The spray bottles used as window cleaners or perfume sprayers work on:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Atomizers and sprayers operate on Bernoulli's principle where fast fluid velocity causes a pressure drop that draws the liquid up.

questions.questionText: Which of the following elements has the largest atomic radius?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Atomic radius decreases across a period from left to right. Lithium is furthest to the left in period 2 and has the largest radius.

questions.questionText: A piece of wire of resistance $R$ is cut into 5 equal parts. These parts are then connected in parallel. If the equivalent resistance of the combination is $R'$, then the ratio $R/R'$ is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Each segment has resistance R/5. In parallel, 1/R' = 5 * (5/R) = 25/R => R' = R/25. Thus R/R' = 25.

questions.questionText: The focal length of a convex lens is $f_L = 10\text{ cm}$. On immersing in water, it will act as a:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Immersing a glass convex lens in water reduces the relative refractive index, increasing its focal length while remaining convex.

questions.questionText: Monochromatic light enters from one medium to another. Which one of the following properties does not change?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Frequency is determined exclusively by the source and does not change across different media during refraction.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a part of the female reproductive system in human beings?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The vas deferens is an anatomical component of the male reproductive system.

questions.questionText: The most important cell type associated with the immunity of the body is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Lymphocytes (T-cells and B-cells) are the primary white blood cells responsible for adaptive immunity.

questions.questionText: Ginger is an underground stem and not a root because:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Stems are defined morphologically by the presence of nodes and internodes, which ginger possesses.

questions.questionText: The process involved in achieving Green Hydrogen from water is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Green hydrogen is generated through the electrolysis of water utilizing renewable energy sources.

questions.questionText: Which agency in India has launched the UTSAH portal?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The University Grants Commission (UGC) launched the UTSAH portal to track implementation of NEP 2020 initiatives.

questions.questionText: Which year was declared by the UNO as the 'International Year of Millets'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Following a proposal spearheaded by India, the UN General Assembly declared 2023 as the International Year of Millets.

questions.questionText: Who is the architect of the new Parliament building of India?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dr. Bimal Patel of HCP Design designed the new Parliament building as part of the Central Vista Redevelopment.

questions.questionText: When is 'Human Rights Day' celebrated annually?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Human Rights Day is observed globally on 10 December to mark the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948.

questions.questionText: In which country did India launch its Unified Payments Interface (UPI) cross-border link recently?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: India has expanded UPI cross-border links to multiple countries including France, UAE, and Mauritius, making 'More than one of the above' correct.

questions.questionText: Who was the writer of 'Banglar Mati, Banglar Jal'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore composed 'Banglar Mati, Banglar Jal' in 1905 during the anti-partition Swadeshi movement in Bengal.

questions.questionText: In which State is 'Raksha Bandhan' celebrated as 'Tree Safety Day' (Vriksha Suraksha Diwas)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bihar observes Raksha Bandhan as Vriksha Suraksha Diwas to promote environmental stewardship and tree protection.

questions.questionText: Which was the first movie made in Bhojpuri language?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'Ganga Maiya Tohe Piyari Chadhaibo' (1963) was the first Bhojpuri feature film.

questions.questionText: 'Malnad' region is associated with which of the following plateaus of India?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Malnad is the hilly western physiographic zone of the Karnataka Plateau adjacent to the Western Ghats.

questions.questionText: In which district of Bihar is Paddy crop production the maximum?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rohtas district leads Bihar in total paddy cultivation and output, often termed the 'Rice Bowl of Bihar'.

questions.questionText: In which district of Bihar is silk textile production the maximum?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bhagalpur is renowned throughout India as the 'Silk City' for its traditional Tussar silk production.

questions.questionText: Which two extreme locations are connected by the East-West Corridor in India?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The East-West Corridor of the Golden Quadrilateral connects Silchar in Assam to Porbandar in Gujarat.

questions.questionText: Who is known as the 'Prophet of New India' / Father of Modern India?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Raja Ram Mohan Roy is recognized as the Father of Modern India and the Prophet of New India for initiating socio-cultural renaissance.

questions.questionText: Which revolt is prominently mentioned in Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's novel 'Anandamath'?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra's 'Anandamath' is set against the historical background of the 18th-century Sannyasi Rebellion in Bengal.

questions.questionText: Who was the founder of 'Abhinav Bharat' secret society in London?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Vinayak Damodar (Veer) Savarkar led and established the Abhinav Bharat society branches in India and London.

questions.questionText: Who formed the Bihar Socialist Party in 1931?
questions.optionA: Phulan Prasad Varma and Jayaprakash Narayan
questions.optionB: Phulan Chand Tiwari and Rajendra Prasad
questions.optionC: Raj Kumar Shukla and Swami Agnivesh
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bihar Socialist Party was established in 1931 by Phulan Prasad Varma, Jayaprakash Narayan, and Ganga Sharan Singh.

questions.questionText: Who established a branch of the Anushilan Samiti in Patna in 1913?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sachindra Nath Sanyal set up a branch of the revolutionary organization Anushilan Samiti in Patna in 1913.

questions.questionText: Who was the President of the Indian National Congress at the Gaya Session of 1922?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das presided over the 37th session of the Indian National Congress held in Gaya in December 1922.

questions.questionText: Who led the peasants of Bihar during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Swami Vidyanand led peasant movements in northern Bihar, particularly across the Darbhanga Raj estates during 1919-1922.

questions.questionText: The All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) was founded in 1936 under the leadership of:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati was the founder and first President of the All India Kisan Sabha formed in Lucknow in 1936.

questions.questionText: Who was the Viceroy of India during the Jallianwala Bagh massacre (1919)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Lord Chelmsford served as Viceroy of India from 1916 to 1921 when the Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on 13 April 1919.

questions.questionText: Digital circuits can be made by the repeated use of which universal gates?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both NAND and NOR are universal gates capable of synthesizing any combinational or sequential Boolean circuit.

questions.questionText: An OR gate has 4 inputs. How many input combinations (rows) will be in its truth table?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: For an n-input gate, the truth table consists of 2^n rows. With 4 inputs, 2^4 = 16 rows.

questions.questionText: What is the result of the bitwise operation 1010 AND 1100 in binary?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 1010 AND 1100 yields 1000 because only the first bit is 1 in both binary strings.

questions.questionText: In a half-adder digital circuit, the outputs produced are:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A half-adder accepts two single-bit binary inputs and computes their Sum (XOR) and Carry (AND).

questions.questionText: How many select lines are required for an 8-to-1 multiplexer?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: For an n-to-1 multiplexer, 2^m = n where m is select lines. For n = 8, 2^3 = 8, so 3 select lines are required.

questions.questionText: Convert decimal number 1234 to binary, octal, and hexadecimal:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 1234 / 16 gives 4D2; 1234 / 8 gives 2322; converted to base-2 gives 10011010010.

questions.questionText: What is Booth's algorithm used for?
questions.optionB: Fast multiplication of signed binary numbers
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Booth's algorithm multiplies signed binary numbers in two's complement representation efficiently.

questions.questionText: The expression $Y = AB + BC + AC$ represents which form?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The terms are ANDed products summed together via OR, representing Sum of Products (SOP).

questions.questionText: The dual of a Boolean expression is obtained by:
questions.optionB: interchanging all 0s and 1s, and interchanging all '+' and '$\cdot$' signs
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The principle of duality replaces AND with OR (+ with .) and 0 with 1, leaving variable literals uncomplemented.

questions.questionText: What does the Control Unit generate to synchronize and direct computer operations?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Control Unit generates control and timing signals to coordinate data path operations throughout the CPU.

questions.questionText: In memory-mapped I/O scheme:
questions.optionA: I/O devices and memory share the same address space
questions.optionB: I/O devices have a completely separate address space
questions.optionC: Special instructions like IN and OUT must be used
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In memory-mapped I/O, peripheral device registers are mapped into the standard memory address space.

questions.questionText: What addressing mode is used in an instruction of the form ADD X, Y where X and Y are memory locations?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Specifying absolute memory addresses directly within the instruction corresponds to direct or absolute addressing.

questions.questionText: In digital electronics, to display decimal digits on a railway platform clock, which IC/circuit is typically used?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A BCD-to-seven-segment decoder drives numeric indicator LED/LCD panels.

questions.questionText: Which of the following natural elements is the primary semiconductor used in computer microchips?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Silicon is the principal semiconductor substrate used in planar integrated circuit manufacturing.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a valid identifier/variable name in C/C++?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Identifiers in C/C++ cannot begin with a numerical digit.

questions.questionText:
What will happen if the following C++ code is executed?
C++

int *ptr = NULL;delete ptr;
(A) The program gives compile-time error
(B) The program is compiled and executed successfully
(C) The program gives runtime segmentation fault
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: The program is compiled and executed successfully
questions.optionC: The program gives runtime segmentation fault
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In standard C++, invoking delete on a NULL pointer is completely safe and performs a no-op.

questions.questionText:
What is the difference between delete and delete[] in C++?
(A) delete is syntactically wrong
(B) delete is used for single objects, while delete[] is used to deallocate arrays of objects
(C) delete is for pointers, delete[] is for variables
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: delete is used for single objects, while delete[] is used to deallocate arrays of objects
questions.optionC: delete is for pointers, delete[] is for variables
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'delete' deallocates memory allocated with 'new', while 'delete[]' invokes destructors and frees arrays allocated with 'new[]'.

questions.optionA: Error in C and successful execution in C++
questions.optionB: Error in both C and C++
questions.optionC: Error in C++ and successful execution in C
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'new' is a reserved keyword in C++ (causing compile error), but is a valid user identifier in standard C.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText:
How do structures (struct) and classes (class) differ in C++?
(A) In structures members are private by default, in classes public by default
(B) In structures members are public by default, in classes they are private by default
(C) Structures cannot have member functions
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: In structures members are private by default, in classes public by default
questions.optionB: In structures members are public by default, in classes they are private by default
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In C++, struct members default to public access, whereas class members default to private access.

questions.questionText:
What is an abstract class in C++?
(A) Any class that has an instance
(B) A class that cannot be inherited
(C) A class containing at least one pure virtual function
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: Any class that has an instance
questions.optionB: A class that cannot be inherited
questions.optionC: A class containing at least one pure virtual function
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A class with at least one pure virtual function (= 0) is an abstract class and cannot be instantiated.

questions.questionText:
What is virtual inheritance in C++ used for?
(A) To speed up program execution
(B) To access private members of base class
(C) To avoid multiple copies of a base class in the derived class (Diamond Problem)
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: To access private members of base class
questions.optionC: To avoid multiple copies of a base class in the derived class (Diamond Problem)
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Virtual base classes resolve ambiguity in multipath/diamond inheritance by ensuring only a single subobject is inherited.

questions.questionText:
Which constructor is automatically synthesized by the C++ compiler if no constructor is explicitly declared?
(A) Copy constructor
(B) Default constructor
(C) Parameterized constructor
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: If no user-defined constructors exist, the compiler implicitly provides a default parameterless constructor.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following features must be supported by a language to be considered Object-Oriented?
(A) Encapsulation
(B) Inheritance
(C) Polymorphism
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction form the core pillars of OOP.

questions.questionText:
Who is the original creator of the C++ programming language?
(A) Dennis Ritchie
(B) Bjarne Stroustrup
(C) James Gosling
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bjarne Stroustrup designed and implemented C++ at Bell Labs beginning in 1979.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Expressions inside sizeof are not evaluated at runtime in C; sizeof(int) is 4, and k remains 15.

questions.questionText:
How is compile-time polymorphism achieved in C++?
(A) Function overloading and Templates
(B) Virtual functions
(C) Dynamic binding
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compile-time (static) polymorphism is implemented via function/operator overloading and templates.

questions.questionText:
The mechanism of binding data and the functions that manipulate them into a single unit is known as:
(A) Abstraction
(B) Polymorphism
(C) Encapsulation
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Encapsulation bundles data members and methods inside a class while restricting direct external access.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is primarily used to implement recursion and function call management?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The call stack manages function activation records and local scopes during recursive executions.

questions.questionText: What is the postfix expression for the infix expression: $a + b * c + (d * e)$?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: b*c -> bc*; a + bc* -> abc*+; (d*e) -> de*; sum gives abc*+de*+.

questions.questionText: What is the result of evaluating the postfix expression: 10 5 + 60 6 / * 8 -?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: The essential condition that must be verified before deleting an element from a queue is:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Before dequeueing, the queue must be checked to confirm it is not empty, avoiding underflow.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText: What is another name commonly used for a circular queue?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Because the end wraps around to the beginning, circular queues are frequently called ring buffers.

questions.questionText: What is the main advantage of using a circular queue over a linear queue implemented with an array?
questions.optionB: It avoids memory wastage caused by unused space at the front
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A circular queue reuses vacated array slots at the front after elements have been dequeued.

questions.questionText: In an AVL (height-balanced) binary tree, the height difference between the left and right subtrees of any node cannot exceed:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The balance factor of any node in an AVL tree must remain in {-1, 0, +1}.

questions.questionText: The preorder traversal of a Binary Search Tree is: 15, 10, 12, 11, 20, 18, 16, 19. What is its postorder traversal?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sorting yields in-order: 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20. Reconstructing the tree and traversing post-order gives 11, 12, 10, 16, 19, 18, 20, 15.

questions.questionText: How many structurally distinct Binary Search Trees (BSTs) can be formed with 4 distinct keys?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The count is the 4th Catalan number: C_4 = (1/5) * (8! / (4! * 4!)) = 14.

questions.questionText: Which of the following sorting algorithms follows the Divide and Conquer paradigm?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both Merge Sort and Quick Sort are divide-and-conquer algorithms, so 'More than one of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: How many edges does a spanning tree of a connected graph with $N$ vertices always have?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Every spanning tree connecting N vertices contains exactly N - 1 edges.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is best suited for implementing a Priority Queue efficiently?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A binary heap provides O(log n) insertions and extractions, making it optimal for priority queues.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity of searching an element in a balanced binary search tree of $N$ nodes?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In a balanced BST, tree height is O(log N), bounding search time to O(log N).

questions.questionText: SQL Views are also recognized as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A view is a virtual table defined over the result set of an underlying SQL query.

questions.questionText: How many Primary Keys can exist in a relational database table?
questions.optionC: As many as the number of columns
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A relational table can define at most one primary key constraint, which may be simple or composite.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an integrity constraint in SQL?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: UNION is a set operator that combines query results; Primary Key and Not Null are table constraints.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a standard SQL aggregate function?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: COMPUTE is not a standard ANSI SQL aggregate function like COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX.

questions.questionText: If no sorting order is specified in an SQL ORDER BY clause, what is the default ordering?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: ORDER BY sorts query results in ascending (ASC) order by default.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true regarding the HAVING clause in SQL?
questions.optionB: Filters groups after aggregation, unlike WHERE which filters individual rows
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: HAVING applies filter predicates to aggregated row groups produced by GROUP BY.

questions.questionText:
What will the following SQL statement output in Oracle SQL?
SELECT ROUND(65.726, -1) FROM DUAL;
(A) 70
(B) 65.7
(C) 60
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A negative scale (-1) rounds to the nearest tens place, turning 65.726 into 70.

questions.questionText: Which SQL command makes all updates made by the active transaction permanent in the database?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The COMMIT statement finalizes transactional modifications permanently to storage.

questions.questionText:
The Referential Integrity constraint ensures that:
(A) Foreign key values in a referencing table must match existing primary key values in the referenced table
(B) A table cannot have duplicate rows
(C) Primary keys cannot contain negative numbers
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: Foreign key values in a referencing table must match existing primary key values in the referenced table
questions.optionB: A table cannot have duplicate rows
questions.optionC: Primary keys cannot contain negative numbers
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Referential integrity requires foreign key entries to reference valid candidate keys in parent relations or be NULL.

questions.questionText:
A superkey is defined as:
(A) A minimal candidate key
(B) A set of one or more attributes that uniquely identify a tuple within a relation
(C) Any attribute that cannot contain null values
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: A set of one or more attributes that uniquely identify a tuple within a relation
questions.optionC: Any attribute that cannot contain null values
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Any set of attributes that uniquely distinguishes each row in a table is a superkey.

questions.questionText: Which normal form ensures that no non-prime attribute is transitively dependent on the candidate key?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Third Normal Form (3NF) requires 2NF compliance and the elimination of transitive dependencies for non-prime attributes.

questions.questionText: Which data type in modern relational DBMS can store large raw binary data like images or audio?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Binary Large Objects (BLOB) or RAW data types store unstructured binary files like audio, video, or images.

questions.questionText:
The primary purpose of memory compaction in contiguous memory allocation is:
(A) To eliminate internal fragmentation
(B) To collect all free memory holes into one large contiguous block to overcome external fragmentation
(C) To increase cache hit ratio
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: To collect all free memory holes into one large contiguous block to overcome external fragmentation
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Compaction relocates occupied memory blocks together, consolidating scattered free space into a contiguous chunk to resolve external fragmentation.

questions.questionText:
A compiler is a language translator which:
(A) Converts high-level source code into target machine/object code as a whole
(B) Executes program line-by-line
(C) Directly produces final execution output without generating object code
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: Converts high-level source code into target machine/object code as a whole
questions.optionC: Directly produces final execution output without generating object code
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A compiler scans and translates the entire high-level program into machine/object code prior to execution.

questions.questionText:
What is a "page" in virtual memory systems?
(A) A fixed-size contiguous block of virtual memory
(B) A fixed-size block of physical RAM
(C) A segment descriptor table
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: A fixed-size contiguous block of virtual memory
questions.optionB: A fixed-size block of physical RAM
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In paging, logical virtual memory is partitioned into fixed-sized pages, which map to physical memory frames.

questions.questionText: For a virtual memory system with 4 KB page size, how many bits are required for the page offset?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Offset bits = log2(4 * 1024 bytes) = log2(4096) = 12 bits.

questions.questionText:
What causes thrashing in an operating system?
(A) High CPU clock frequency
(B) Excessive page fault and swapping activity leading to little useful computation
(C) Disk sector failure
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: Excessive page fault and swapping activity leading to little useful computation
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Thrashing occurs when an OS spends more time servicing page faults and swapping than executing productive instructions.

questions.questionText:
Consider a disk queue: 98, 183, 37, 122, 14, 124, 65, 67. With FCFS scheduling, if the head is initially at 53, the total head movements (cylinders) is:
(A) 640
(B) 620
(C) 630
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText:
Threads belonging to the same process share which of the following?
(A) Code section and Data section
(B) Program counter
(C) Thread ID and stack
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Threads in a process share code, data sections, and OS resources, but maintain private registers, program counters, and stacks.

questions.questionText:
The method of interacting with I/O devices by repeatedly testing their status registers in a loop is called:
(A) Program-controlled I/O (Polling)
(B) Interrupt-driven I/O
(C) Direct Memory Access (DMA)
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Repeatedly polling device status flags in software is called programmed I/O or polling.

questions.questionText: Which network topology requires a central hub or switch?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In star topology, every node connects via a point-to-point link to a central switch or hub.

questions.questionText: What transmission medium is immune to electromagnetic interference (EMI)?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Optical fiber carries signals as light pulses through glass strands, making it completely immune to EMI.

questions.questionText: What is the total length of an IPv6 address?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: An IPv6 address is 128 bits long; as per the official BPSC question formatting where 128 bits was omitted from options A and B, option (E) is marked.

questions.questionText: Which layer of the TCP/IP stack corresponds to the Transport layer of the OSI model?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Host-to-Host transport layer of the TCP/IP stack matches Layer 4 (Transport layer) of the OSI model.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is primarily used to transmit electronic mail between mail servers?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) is the standard push protocol for transferring emails across servers.

questions.questionText: An endpoint of an inter-process communication flow across an IP network (combination of IP and Port) is called:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A socket represents an operational communication endpoint bound to an IP address and port number.

questions.questionText: In asymmetric key cryptography (Public Key Cryptosystem), the private key is held by:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In asymmetric cryptography, the private key must be kept secret by its owner/receiver to decrypt data.

questions.questionText: Which command utilizes ICMP echo requests to verify connectivity and summarize packet loss and latency between two endpoints?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The ping command sends ICMP Echo Requests and listens for Echo Replies to measure reachability and round-trip time.

questions.questionText:
What is the primary distinction between Verification and Validation in software engineering?
(A) Verification ensures code runs fast, Validation ensures zero lines of bugs
(B) Verification checks "Are we building the product right?", while Validation checks "Are we building the right product?"
(C) Verification is done by users, Validation is done by coders
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: Verification ensures code runs fast, Validation ensures zero lines of bugs
questions.optionB: Verification checks "Are we building the product right?", while Validation checks "Are we building the right product?"
questions.optionC: Verification is done by users, Validation is done by coders
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Verification assesses adherence to specifications ('building product right'), whereas validation evaluates meeting user expectations ('building right product').

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) model?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Waterfall, Agile, and Spiral are all recognized SDLC process models, so 'More than one of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText: What is the primary role of HTML in web application development?
questions.optionA: To define the structural layout of web documents
questions.optionC: To manage client-side state across sessions
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: HTML defines the semantic document structure and content hierarchy of web pages.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is considered an undecidable / non-computable problem in Theory of Computation?
questions.optionC: Finding shortest path in a DAG
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Alan Turing proved in 1936 that the Halting Problem cannot be solved by any general algorithm, making it undecidable.

questions.questionText: Which lightweight messaging protocol is widely used in Internet of Things (IoT) applications?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both MQTT and CoAP are lightweight protocols specifically engineered for constrained IoT nodes and telemetry.

questions.questionText: Which of the following algorithms is categorized under Supervised Machine Learning?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Decision Tree and Linear Regression are supervised learning algorithms; K-Means is unsupervised.

questions.questionText: In E-Commerce classification, an online marketplace where individuals sell used products directly to other consumers (like OLX or eBay) is classified as:
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Peer-to-peer customer transactions are classified as Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) e-commerce.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used in Java to inherit a class?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Java, a subclass inherits from a superclass using the 'extends' keyword.

questions.questionText: What is the computational time complexity of converting an infix mathematical expression to postfix using a stack?
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The shunting-yard algorithm processes each token in constant time, achieving linear O(N) complexity.

questions.questionText:
A sparse matrix of size $m \times n$ is defined as one in which:
(A) The total number of zero elements $> (m \times n)/2$
(B) The total number of non-zero elements is greater than zero elements
(C) All elements are diagonal only
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: The total number of zero elements $> (m \times n)/2$
questions.optionB: The total number of non-zero elements is greater than zero elements
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A matrix is classified as sparse when more than half of its total elements (m * n / 2) are zeroes.
